allTrustedDogfood.note: Includes two broader independent audits; use the focused dogfood for the bounded Wave 8 regression, not as a like-for-like total-token forecast.

interpretation: The focused worker proves a physical fresh thread and a bounded active-context proxy; it does not estimate the unknown Wave 8 pre-change peak.
Fresh contexts do not guarantee lower total tokens: two earlier broad implementation workers used 1672792 and 1367427 input-plus-output tokens, so brief quality and read discipline remain material.
Read relevance is unavailable because Codex JSONL did not expose classified file-read events; the harness does not invent that metric.
